body: A011 self-review finding: stable-subject UUID validation must enforce lowercase canonical shape without assuming RFC version/variant bits; owner approval must carry signature bytes and signing-key identity separately from ENV values. Addressed in the schemas and fixtures.
author: Codex

replies.body: Resolved: both schemas now accept any lowercase canonical UUID shape without unsupported version-bit constraints; owner_approval now requires signing_key_id and signature_base64 while environment remains a separate strict object. Fixture validation and golden-vector recomputation are green.
